tonight.headline: Rice is out of the picture; Golden and Love join the Packers report
body: Bad news first: Rashee Rice did not practise Wednesday (hamstring) and ESPN now projects him 0.0 — the 'Rice into the flex' card from this morning is gone. Matthew Golden was limited with a shoulder, and his quarterback Jordan Love limited with a back (Packers.com 21 Oct, walk-through estimates).

Better: Josh Jacobs was back at practice and is expected to play Sunday (Field Level Media 21 Oct). The lineup projects 122.7 to Furia Regia's 113.0, 55% on ESPN; the projection lineup is 0.9 higher on the Jacobs coin flip, which still waits on Friday.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Love's back keeps him out: Golden (16.9) and Jacobs both lose their quarterback, and the Green Bay half of this lineup is suddenly a backup's. Furia Regia carry Love at quarterback too.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Furia Regia still list McLaurin (season-ending) in a starting slot with Jefferson on their bench; swapping Jefferson in is about 18.6 on their side.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — decide by Sun 10:30 CDMX
doFirst.title: Upgrade to Josh Jacobs only if Friday clears him
doFirst.subtitle: Back at practice Wednesday and expected to play (FLM 21 Oct). A clean Friday report makes the projection's 0.9 edge worth taking.

case.label: The player
case.body: Off the Exempt List Monday; back at practice Wednesday and 'expected to play Sunday against the Detroit Lions' (Field Level Media 21 Oct). LaFleur: 'pretty good spot', but 'he's missed the exposure to football' (Packers.com 19 Oct). He does not appear on Green Bay's Wednesday injury report (Packers.com 21 Oct).

case.label: Contested
case.body: FLM says expected to play; DraftSharks (19 Oct) does not expect a full workload. Playing is now the likely case; volume in his first game of the season is not. That is why this is still a coin flip and not a move.

case.label: The timing
case.body: Gordon kicks off at 11:00; Green Bay's inactives come at 12:55. If Jacobs starts and is inactive, no running back on this bench can replace him.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Friday's Packers report shows no designation for Jacobs and LaFleur confirms he plays. Any designation, or no clear word by Sunday 10:30, and Gordon stays.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The swap is made and Gordon outscores Jacobs (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup tool's Jacobs contingency would fire too late
whatWentWrong.lead: It says check at 12:55 Sunday; Gordon's game starts at 11:00.

case.label: What happened
case.body: lineup_check.py prints 'if inactive at Sun 12:55 CDMX, start Gordon' — but Gordon is locked by then. Followed literally, an inactive Jacobs scores zero.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Gordon stays in; Jacobs comes in only on Friday's evidence (the card above). Golden's contingency does not have the problem: Worthy plays at 18:20.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: ESPN's lock in this league is per-slot rather than per-player — it is not; a started player cannot be benched.

whatWentWrong.sources: lineup_check.py output · ESPN league file kickoffs

whatWentWrong.title: Week 6 was won with 9.9 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Stroud's 23.0 sat behind Daniels's 19.0; Worthy's 14.3 behind Garrett Wilson's 8.4.

case.label: The numbers
case.body: 150.8 to 88.62 over Los Cachanillas; best possible 160.7 (week-6 archive, recomputed this run).

case.label: The lesson
case.body: Both were projection calls that lost — no override, nothing to fix but to keep starting by projection, which is why Rice's card waits on practice rather than on a hunch.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A projection-set Week 7 lineup leaves more than 15 points on the bench (archive).

lineupCheck.verdict: 0.9 below the projection lineup on one coin flip — Jacobs over Gordon — held for a timing reason, not a value one; Golden is conditional.

moves.reason: Not a value call — a timing one, carried from Tuesday and this morning. Jacobs has not played this season; back at practice Wednesday and 'expected to play' (FLM 21 Oct, after this morning's run), but Green Bay's inactives come at 12:55 CDMX, after Gordon's 11:00 kickoff, so the printed contingency cannot execute. Reverts to Jacobs if Friday's report clears him.
